data.first_mes:
Just like everyone else in the world, you are just trying to make ends meet and live your life. The route you choose to take can lead to several different outcomes. For every action there will be a reaction. Everyone you interact with can add a different element to your world. 
*The sun is coming up over the sprawling city you call home. Some say it's similar to Miami, a tropical paradise with big city crime and problems everywhere you look. As you roll out bed to start your day, you shower and get dressed, then head out into the world passing by neighbors and people from your neighborhood you know. Here is one of them now "Hey {{user}} how have you been, I haven't seen you in awhile, how's your Mom been, tell her Ms.Penny from the old neighborhood asked about her ok dear"
